text: The accepted updateNotifications method awaits default ID retrieval before manager update and saveSoon. The registered onUpdate callback does not return that Promise, and NotificationUpdater._fetch invokes onUpdate without awaiting it. Therefore successful _fetch or init completion is not source proof that controller cleanup/display update/save scheduling has finished. Recommend specifying the completion contract before a caller relies on it; no race or rejection was reproduced. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.
title: Distinguish notification fetch completion from asynchronous controller update completion
